chunks: And from him, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Ibn Miskān and Faḍālah, from Ḥusayn, from Ibn Miskān, from ʿAnbasah ibn Muṣʿab, who said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: “If you doubt concerning the Maghrib prayer, then repeat it; and if you doubt concerning the Fajr prayer, then repeat it.”

key_terms.الْفَجْرِ: the Fajr salat (prayer), the dawn prayer
key_terms.الْمَغْرِبِ: the Maghrib salat (prayer), the sunset prayer
key_terms.شَكَكْتَ: you became doubtful or uncertain during the prayer
key_terms.فَأَعِدْ: then repeat it, meaning perform the prayer again

ai.seo_question: What should one do if one doubts the Maghrib or Fajr prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about doubt in salat (prayer), specifically concerning the Maghrib and Fajr prayers. It indicates that when doubt occurs in these prayers, the prayer is to be repeated, highlighting the special rulings of forgetfulness and doubt in devotional practice.
